verdict.rationale: Featurebase's evidence covers webhooks, API references, workflows, integrations, and changelogs, but nothing describes a real-time task status view showing blockers or last-update details for in-progress work — this is a fair capability to expect from a feedback-to-tasks roadmap tool, but no evidence supports it. missing for 10: task-level status dashboard, 'blocked on' field/tracking, last-update timestamps or activity feed per task.
